data.name: MGH2_001
data.value: Strange thing is,[pause=10] nobody seems to know the actual reason why they've been appearing more...

data.name: MGH2_002
data.value: It seems as though the world is becoming more dangerous by the day...

data.name: MGH2_003
data.value: These are scary times to live in...

data.name: MGH2_004
data.value: It really is a shame {0} is missing...[pause=0] But I wish it wouldn't stop {1} from hanging out...

data.name: MGH3_001
data.value: Still,[pause=10] I wonder if they'll be enough to tackle all the problems the future holds...

data.name: MGH3_002
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] this dangerous world that we live in gets more perilous by the day...

data.name: MGH4_001
data.value: Things are getting so dangerous,[pause=10] it's all I can think about...

data.name: MGH4_002
data.value: Things just seem so dire lately,[pause=10] honey...[pause=0] The danger in the world is bringing me down...

data.name: MGH4_003
data.value: Oh dear,[pause=10] you shouldn't worry so much![pause=0] You overthink things!

data.name: MGH4_004
data.value: You just need to think about these sorts of things less!

data.name: MGH4_005
data.value: I wish it were that easy...

data.name: MGH4_006
data.value: Things just seem so dire lately,[pause=10] honey...[pause=0] The danger in the world is bringing me down...

data.name: MGH4_007
data.value: Oh dear,[pause=10] you shouldn't worry so much![pause=0] Everything's gonna be just fine!

data.name: MGH4_008
data.value: And if something bad does happen,[pause=10] me and the kids will always be with you![pause=0] We're a family!

data.name: MGH4_009
data.value: That's...[pause=30] true![pause=0] That does make me feel better about everything that's been going on.

data.name: MGH4_010
data.value: Thanks honey.[pause=0] I don't know what I'd do without you.

data.name: MGH4_011
data.value: Of course dear![pause=0] We're always here for you,[pause=10] don't ever forget that!

data.name: MGH6_001
data.value: Three famous rivals in town, and the whole guild off in the mountains...[pause=10] I haven't slept right in days.

data.name: MGH6_002
data.value: What if something happens while our heroes are away?[pause=0] Who's supposed to protect us then?

data.name: MGH6_003
data.value: Now they want us to trust a lost bug's rescue to those three?[pause=10] They didn't even blink.

data.name: MGH6_004
data.value: A child is missing in that forest and they call it beneath them.[pause=0] I can't stop thinking about it.

data.name: MGH6_005
data.value: You're really going in there yourselves?[pause=0] That forest doesn't feel right lately.

data.name: MGH6_006
data.value: Bring that little one home.[pause=0] I won't rest easy until you do.

data.name: MGH6_007
data.value: You actually did it![pause=0] I heard the whole street cheering.

data.name: MGH6_008
data.value: Chrysi keeps saying "I told you it would be fine."[pause=0] ...She's insufferable when she's right.

data.name: MGH6_009
data.value: Bogen's been pacing since this morning.[pause=0] Three famous explorers show up and he panics about everything else.

data.name: MGH6_010
data.value: Meanwhile the kids just want to know if they have cool capes.[pause=0] Kids have their priorities straight.

data.name: MGH6_011
data.value: He's worried about that missing Venipede now.[pause=0] I told him worrying won't find the bug faster.

data.name: MGH6_012
data.value: But he keeps setting an extra plate at dinner, just in case someone brings good news.[pause=0] That's my Bogen.

data.name: MGH6_013
data.value: Extra plate wasn't needed after all![pause=0] You brought the news home yourselves. Thank you.
